name: cobol-feature-levels-dialect-uniform
body: Dialect::feature_level returns the SPEC §19.5 starting levels (ALTER and GO TO without a name obsolete, ENTRY ok, section segments ignore) identically under every dialect. Limit: no per-dialect construct levels are sourced, so a construct cannot yet differ in level between dialects. Upgrade when per-dialect feature data is sourced, before any dialect-specific diagnostic behaviour is relied on.
